author: codex-ai-persistence

selection.basis: First two chronological primaries per port/sensor from predeclared round1; selection predates image/model inspection.

prior_exposure.context: Reviewed training report schemas and code/protocol. Previous metadata-only audit confirmed some S1 held-out rasters are entirely nodata; no S2 test proposals or labels were inspected.

coordinate_convention: Native pixel edges [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax], half-open; exact CRS/affine per source. Roughly1–2 native-pixel boundary uncertainty; no physical dimensions inferred. WGS84 digits reflect transformation precision, not annotation accuracy.
method: Evidence IDs, SHA256 and acquisition/quality metadata pinned before raw inspection. No detection table, counts, scores or model geometry read.
Full unannotated native mosaics inspected, then nearest-neighbor crops across all zone extents and per-object crops. No superresolution or generated details.
Zone overlap RGB equivalence verified; STC fondeo viewed from its own asset because STC canal has unfilled northwest context.
Visible objects manually localized; zone membership uses centroid. Objects outside all zones remain context only.
Registered valid/observable masks constrain review; ambiguous berth strips and non-reviewed parts remain unknown. No source-mask override.
TEST references are proposals for separate independent adjudication/freezing. No training, calibration, inference or evaluation metrics computed.

After immutable raw lock, read only detection_id, observation_id and geometry_json. Associate each unambiguous independent visual reference to its unique nearby geographic proposal; corrections retain exactly the raw visual geometry.

No scopes or raw positives changed during correspondence. Unresolved proposals may block freezing where their automatic boxes touch a reviewed area; these are explicitly listed rather than silently rejected or excluded.
annotation_notes: Boxes manually localized after full raw mosaic and per-object nearest-neighbor crops. V06 excludes long wake; V27 is the large harbor hull whose centroid is outside all configured zones. No model proposal consultation.
